item.text: Clean data: 320 students, 14 classes, no nulls in `Jun-25`. Let me compute the total and per-class breakdown.

item.command:
/bin/sh -lc "cd /work && python3 -c \"
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('students_2025_26.xlsx', sheet_name='Attendance')

# Validate: is Total Present == sum of the 6 monthly columns? (sanity check)
month_cols = ['Apr-25','May-25','Jun-25','Jul-25','Aug-25','Sep-25']
row_sum = df[month_cols].sum(axis=1)
print('Total Present == sum of months for all rows:', (row_sum == df['Total Present']).all())

# Answer: total June 2025 days present across all classes
june_total = df['Jun-25'].sum()
print('Total students (rows):', len(df))
print('Unique student IDs:', df['Attendance ID'].nunique())
print('TOTAL JUNE 2025 DAYS PRESENT (all classes):', int(june_total))
print()

# Per-class breakdown
by_class = df.groupby('Class')['Jun-25'].agg(['count','sum']).reset_index()
by_class.columns = ['Class','Students','Jun-25 Present Days']
print(by_class.to_string(index=False))
print()
print('Check per-class sums add up:', int(by_class['Jun-25 Present Days'].sum()), '==', int(june_total))
\""
